card.name: Inside CT and radar imaging terms
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of imaging technique names, such as detector, helical, aperture, multiphase or dual-phase, and the word CT after Coronary. Seen in CT scan and contrast-dose text, and once in radar.

modes.label: Contrast protocol terms
